h1: Rimchon Resort Ang Thong — quiet single-storey garden bungalows, park at your door, easy on the budget
intro: If you want a simple, quiet place in Ang Thong where you can park right outside your door and not pay four figures, Rimchon Resort (Rimchon Resort Ang Thong) is a small 8-room resort in Sala Daeng, Mueang Ang Thong, that passing travellers mention for its calm and its price. The rooms are single-storey bungalows spread through a garden, about 0.9 km from the Ang Thong bus station, near Lotus's and Wat Ton Son, and roughly 2 km from the town centre. It isn't a luxury stay, but the rooms are clean and genuinely usable, and rates from about ฿600/night make it an easy budget pick for travellers.

body.html: What sets Rimchon Resort apart from an in-town block is its single-storey garden-bungalow layout. All 8 rooms are single-storey buildings spread through a green plot, so you can park right outside your door without dragging bags into a lift or walking far. Self-drivers like this because it's convenient and feels private. The surroundings are a residential area and paddy fields, so it's quiet at night — something real reviews repeatedly describe as calm and leafy.

The location works well for drivers. The resort sits on Lam Tha Daeng Road in Sala Daeng, about 0.9 km from the Ang Thong bus station and roughly 1.3 km from the Lotus's Rom Thai branch, with restaurants and convenience stores a short drive away. Wat Ton Son is about 1.6 km off, and central Ang Thong and the market are roughly 2 km, just a few minutes' drive. It suits travellers using Ang Thong as an overnight stop or for errands more than those who want to wander the town centre on foot, since walkable shops are limited.

Rooms range from a Standard double-bed up to a two-bed room. What real reviews consistently praise is that the rooms are clean, genuinely usable and brightly decorated. Each has air-con, a TV, a fridge, a private bathroom and the basic furniture you need for a night or two. With only 8 rooms, the owner and staff can keep an eye on everything, and many guests mention friendly, approachable service.
"Clean room, bright decor, quiet and leafy, easy parking right outside, friendly owner — good value for a stopover in town."

To be honest, Rimchon Resort is a small, locally run place, not a full-facility hotel. There's no pool, gym or on-site restaurant, and with just 8 rooms it fills up fast on weekends and holidays, so it's worth calling ahead. Most bookings are made by phone or through the resort's own page directly, and online rates on some platforms aren't always up to date. Anyone expecting big-hotel service should reset expectations to the level of a clean guesthouse in a garden.

Overall Rimchon Resort scores around 7.6 out of 10 from real guest reviews, rating especially well for value. It isn't a luxury resort, but measured on quiet single-storey bungalows, easy parking, clean rooms and a starting rate near ฿600 (climbing to about ฿850 by room type and season), it does the job of an overnight or errand-trip base in Ang Thong nicely on a comfortable budget — a good fit for travellers who want calm more than a full set of facilities.

The trade-off is simple, pared-back facilities and a small room count, so call ahead to book directly.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Rimchon Resort Ang Thong

faq.q: Where is Rimchon Resort in Ang Thong, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Rimchon Resort is at 57/3 Lam Tha Daeng Road, Sala Daeng, Mueang Ang Thong. It's about 0.9 km from the Ang Thong bus station, near the Lotus's Rom Thai branch and Wat Ton Son, with central Ang Thong and the market roughly 2 km away — a few minutes' drive.

faq.q: How much does Rimchon Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿600/night for a Standard double-bed room. Options run from a Standard 5 ft double and a Superior 6 ft double up to a two-bed room for families. Prices climb to around ฿850 by room type and season, so compare a few channels before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Rimchon Resort?
faq.a: Rooms are single-storey bungalows in a garden, with parking at your door and a quiet feel. Each has air-con, a TV, a fridge and a private bathroom. Real reviews consistently say the rooms are clean, genuinely usable and brightly decorated — fine for a night or two.
Yes — free parking, and you can park right outside your room because the rooms are single-storey bungalows. It's ideal for self-drivers with plenty of luggage, with no lift to deal with or long walk.

faq.q: How do I book Rimchon Resort?
faq.a: As a small 8-room resort, most bookings are made by phone or through the resort's own page directly, with some online platforms also listing it. It's best to call ahead, especially on long weekends or holidays when rooms fill fast.

faq.q: Who is Rimchon Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a good fit for drivers passing through, people running errands, or anyone wanting a quiet room on a budget. It isn't about luxury or full facilities, but the rooms are clean, parking is easy and private, and the location near the bus station and Lotus's works.
